PAVAN KUMAR REDDY KANAKANTI	PHONE: (+91) 9676827221

Email: kpavan1299.it@gmail.com

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Highly motivated IT professional with 5 years of experience specializing in Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse), SharePoint, and RPA tools (UiPath, Automation Anywhere). Proven ability to design, develop, and implement efficient solutions to streamline business processes and drive automation.

SKILLS

Primary

Power Apps

Power Automate

Copilot Studio

Power BI

Power Platform Admin

Dataverse

Graph API

Secondary

SharePoint

UiPath

Automation Anywhere

SQL

Html, CSS, JavaScript

Azure Logic Apps, AI Foundry

Others

Power Platform Strategy

XRM, CoE tool

Azure ML Studio

SPFx

PowerShell

Exchange Online

TECHNICAL SUMMARY

Requirement Analysis & Documentation: Participated in requirement analysis and documentation for client requirements related to Power Platform and automation solutions.

Power Platform Expertise: Experienced professional specialized in Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Copilot Studio) for developing custom solutions and automating workflows.

Power Apps Development: Extensive experience in designing and developing custom solutions using Power Apps (Canvas, Model Driven, Power Pages) for low-code application development, enhancing business processes.

Power Automate Workflow: Proficient in creating and managing automated workflows using Power Automate, integrating with third-party services and automating business processes.

Power BI Dashboards: Proficient in designing and developing interactive Power BI dashboards for data visualization, enabling real-time insights and informed decision-making across business processes.

Copilot Studio: Skilled in utilizing Copilot Studio to enhance development efficiency, leveraging its AI- powered capabilities.

XRM Tool: Experience working with the XRM Tool for data management, configuration, and integration within the Power Platform ecosystem, improving solution customization and performance.

CoE Tool Kit: Proficient in using the Center of Excellence (CoE) Tool Kit to monitor, govern, and manage Power Platform environments and solutions across organizations, ensuring compliance and best practices.

RPA Tools: Skilled in UiPath and Automation Anywhere for robotic process automation (RPA), automating repetitive tasks, and optimizing operational workflows.

Power Platform Governance: Managed and governed Microsoft Power Platform environments using the Power Platform Admin Center, ensuring security, compliance, and efficient user access through role-based access control (RBAC), data loss prevention (DLP) policies, and performance monitoring

Team Collaboration: Strong team player with excellent organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills, delivering effective automation solutions within Agile teams.

JIRA, Azure DevOps, Visio: Experienced in using tools like JIRA, Azure DevOps, and Visio for project management, issue tracking, and team collaboration, ensuring seamless integration and workflow management across development and operational teams. Proficient in managing agile methodologies, tracking progress, and visualizing project timelines and processes.

EXPERIENCE Company Period Location Position KohuTech (Origo) Apr 2025 to Feb 2026 Bangalore Technical Lead Birlasoft Ind (HP) Jun 2023 to Apr 2025 Bangalore Sr Application Developer PersolKelly (Autodesk) Nov 2021 to May 2023 Bangalore Power Apps Developer

EDUCATION

School/University Period Grade Branch Place JNTUA College of Engineering 2017-2020 7.8/10 ECE Anantapur, Andhra Pradesh SV Govt Polytechnic 2014-2017 9.2/10 ECE Tirupati, Andhra Pradesh ZP Govt High School 2013 9.8/10 SSC Peddamandem, Andhra Pradesh

CERTIFICATIONS & ACHIEVEMNETS

PL-600(N12594-0F0070), PL-400, PL-200, PL-100

Udemy (Copilot Studio, Power BI, Gen AI Apps and Solutions)

Power Platform Trainer

ECET AP 8th & TS 10th Rank -2017

JNTUA ECHO – Treasurer

PROJECTS SUMMARY

PHONEBOOK APP - KohuTech

Problem:

Contractors and guest users couldn’t access internal staff details due to the absence of a secure directory, causing communication delays, manual information requests, and risk of exposing sensitive data without proper access controls.

Solution:

Built a secure Power Apps directory using Dataverse as the single source of truth.

Sync AAD data to Dataverse every day using Power Automate

Enabled fast search, sorting, and filtering with optimized UI components.

Implemented role-based access to ensure privacy and compliance.

Added dual view modes, org-chart visualization, and daily automated data syncs.

MY PBI PORTAL - KohuTech Problem:

Embedding Power BI dashboards through third-party domains created governance issues, required duplicate development, lacked user registration and approvals, and offered no scalable security model for external audiences. Solution:

Implemented a Power Pages portal with secure Power BI Embedded integration.

Designed role-based access for anonymous, registered, and admin users.

Used Dataverse for user/company attributes with dynamic RLS filtering.

Automated registration, approval, and access workflows for simplified governance.

Created MDA and Canvas App for Admins

WLP EOL / EOL & EOSL - Birlasoft Problem:

Sales teams depended on large, outdated Excel files to check warranty and lifecycle data, making it difficult to search thousands of serial numbers, leading to days of manual effort, delays in client responses, and lack of a unified system. Solution:

Created a centralized automation solution using Power Apps and Power Automate.

Integrated UiPath (later migrated to Automation Anywhere) to pull data from legacy UI sources.

Automated bulk serial-number processing, email notifications, and live status tracking.

Reused fetched data to reduce repeated lookups and improve response times for sales teams.

AUTOMATION HUB - PersollKelly Problem:

Internal AutoCAD training projects lacked a unified system to track project details, employee hours, knowledge sharing, KPIs, action items, and audit data—resulting in manual tracking and limited visibility.

Solution:

Developed Power Apps modules for project tracking and activity logging.

Automated task updates, schedules, and data workflows using Power Automate.

Implemented centralized data storage for employees, projects, and KPIs.

Built Power BI dashboards for audit reporting and performance insights.
